tools.name: Compoid_search_records
tools.description: Search for records (images, videos, papers, articles, analysis) in Compoid.

tools.name: Compoid_get_record_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific record by its Compoid ID or OAI.

tools.name: Compoid_get_community_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific community by its Compoid ID or OAI.

tools.name: Compoid_download_files
tools.description: Download record files in a zip archive if available through open access.

tools.name: Compoid_upload_file
tools.description:
Upload a file to the Compoid MCP server. Accepts a data URI (data:<mime>;base64,<data>).
    Returns the server-side path to use as file_upload in Compoid_create_record or Compoid_update_record.

tools.name: Compoid_whoami
tools.description: Identify the user behind the configured Compoid API token (user id, email, home community).

tools.name: Compoid_update_record
tools.description:
Update an existing Compoid record (creates a new version, pending review).

    Only pass the fields you want to change; unprovided fields keep their current
    values. An update with no changed fields is rejected as a no-op.

    Required:
        work_id: the record to update - a published record

tools.name: Compoid_delete_record
tools.description:

tools.name: Compoid_create_community
tools.description: Create a new community on Compoid.

tools.name: Compoid_update_community
tools.description: Update an existing community on Compoid. Only supply the fields you want to change.

tools.name: Compoid_search_collections
tools.description: Search for collections within a Compoid community (e.g. Publications, Datasets, subject collections). community_id accepts a UUID or slug; omit query to list all collections.

tools.name: Compoid_get_collection_records
tools.description: Get the records that belong to a specific Compoid collection. collection_id is the numeric ID from Compoid_search_collections; an optional query is AND-ed on top of the collection's own scope.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: Compoid_create_record, Compoid_delete_record · Private data: Compoid_search_records, Compoid_get_record_details, Compoid_download_files, Compoid_upload_file, Compoid_create_record, Compoid_whoami, Compoid_update_record, Compoid_delete_record, Compoid_get_collection_records · Public sink: Compoid_upload_file, Compoid_create_record, Compoid_whoami · Destructive: Compoid_delete_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: Compoid_create_record, Compoid_delete_record · Private data: Compoid_search_records, Compoid_get_record_details, Compoid_download_files, Compoid_upload_file, Compoid_create_record, Compoid_whoami, Compoid_update_record, Compoid_delete_record, Compoid_get_collection_records · Public sink: Compoid_upload_file, Compoid_create_record, Compoid_whoami · Destructive: Compoid_delete_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
